title: Good or Bad? 4 Fruits (v3)
sources_note: Nutrition: USDA FoodData Central (rounded). Prices: approx. US average retail; vary by region/season.

sentences.text: This mango packs forty five grams of sugar.
Four fruits. Good or bad, and what do they really cost?
Banana.
A hundred and five calories, three grams of fiber, and over four hundred milligrams of potassium.
Verdict: good. Perfect fuel before a workout.
About twenty five cents.
Mango.
Loaded with vitamins A and C, but one whole mango is forty five grams of sugar.
Verdict: watch out. Stick to one cup.
About a dollar each.
Orange juice.
Twenty one grams of sugar a glass, and almost zero fiber. Ounce for ounce, it's nearly as sugary as soda.
Verdict: bad, as a daily habit. Eat the orange instead.
About seventy cents a glass.
Blueberries.
Just eighty four calories a cup, packed with antioxidants for your brain and heart.
Verdict: excellent. The best on this list.
Roughly four dollars a pint.
Follow for part two.
Now, back to that mango.
